description: The next hours of a city: temperature, wind, humidity, precipitation and the pollution accumulation index 0–100 (how strongly the weather keeps particles near the ground). A weather estimate, not a PM2.5 forecast.

city.description: City name in any of the site languages, a slug like "russia/krasnoyarsk", or the Atmy city id.

country.description: Country name, to tell apart cities with the same name.

lang.description: Language of city and country names and of the page link; default en.

lat.description: Latitude; with lon, the nearest city with an Atmy summary within 50 km.

name: get_city_forecast
title: Weather and pollution accumulation forecast
